name: Sydney

taxRules.label: Income tax
taxRules.note: ATO thresholds are stated on gross taxable income, with the tax-free threshold expressed as the first bracket rather than as a separate allowance.

taxRules.label: Medicare levy
taxRules.note: 2% of taxable income. The low-income shading range is modelled as a clean cutover, which is immaterial at professional incomes.

healthNote: Medicare covers the baseline. The Medicare Levy Surcharge (1% to 1.5% above roughly $101,000 for singles) is not modelled — most people at this income hold private hospital cover instead, at roughly $1,200 to $2,500 a year. Enter that here if it applies to you.
notes: No joint filing. Australia taxes individuals, so the filing status control is suppressed for this city rather than shown disabled.
Superannuation is 12% paid by the employer on top of salary — real money, but not spendable money, which is why it sits behind the "count retirement savings" toggle.
Legislated: the 16% band falls to 15% from 1 July 2026 and 14% from 1 July 2027. Model those as separate dated records rather than editing this one.
